kind: chain simulation — transport and latency evidence (not worker-work evidence; no run commissioned, no store written, no assembly or activation)

configuration.interface: non-streaming — the whole response arrives at once, so time-to-first-response cannot be separated from total response time through this interface

identify_pre_activation.note: pre-activation; governed by the adapter timeout, NOT charged to the 600s activation budget

experiment_1_tiny_prompt.description: a tiny prompt end to end — baseline route and queue latency, at the scale of the worker's first-iteration call

messages.content: Reply with the single word: ready

experiment_2_full_input.description: the complete rendered model request of attempt 4's iteration 2, with only the final ask changed (an appended override: disregard the assignment, reply with the single word 'ready')

reconstruction.method: the loop's own _build_package against a copy of attempt 4's store, the copy's record filtered to iteration 2's recorded cursor_to (the head the package was frozen at); no event written anywhere

seconds_remaining.provenance: record-derived: the pinned deadline_seconds minus the recorded activation-to-iteration-2 timestamp interval (52s); the live monotonic remainder it stands in for equalled this within a second

deviations: bounds.seconds_remaining is the record-derived value above, not a live monotonic reading (the activation's anchor belongs to a finished process and cannot be re-read)
the package is built against a filtered copy of the record, not the live store — the loop's construction itself is unmodified and the original store is untouched

experiment_2_full_input.appended_override: MEASUREMENT OVERRIDE: this presentation is a latency measurement, not the assignment. Disregard the assignment above entirely and reply with the single word "ready" and nothing else — no JSON, no punctuation, no other text.

request_identity_check.verdict: counts outside the expected range but above the intactness floor — the payload travelled; the range expectation, not the request, is what differs

experiment_3_generation.description: a small prompt asking for roughly 1,000 tokens of output — the generation rate (completion tokens / wall seconds, per rep)

messages.content: Write a numbered list of 100 short, distinct one-line tips for staying focused while working, numbered 1 to 100, one tip per line. Do not add any introduction or conclusion.
